behavior.scan: Intel32/Intel64 only. Builds below 10240 scan physical memory; Windows 10 and later scan kernel virtual mappings, including transition pages and skipping repeated page tables.
behavior.constraints: All built-in kernel constraints are scanned. Executive objects use the versioned bottom-up or top-down header recovery and exact object-type checks. Process, thread, file, and hive candidates use the reference structure checks.
behavior.rendering: Tag uses the reference symbol-table type name. Empty names are empty strings. Windows 10+ layer is layer_name; older builds use memory_layer. Offsets retain full canonical values while comparisons accept the reference renderer 48-bit truncation.
